standard_prerequisites.name: The descent of the property of being locally of finite type along a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 3578-3581) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the property from the base change back to the original map of schemes.

core_obligations: Choose covers: the proof picks a smooth cover of the target by an algebraic space and a smooth cover of the fibre product, reducing the claim to the induced morphism between those spaces (proof lines 3563-3566)

Base change everything: it then base changes the whole setup along the given cover, noting that the smoothness of the cover is preserved and that the definition together with the hypothesis gives that the base changed map of schemes is locally of finite type (proof lines 3567-3576)

Descend: since the base changed target is a surjective flat cover of finite presentation of the original target, the descent statement for the property gives the conclusion for the original map of schemes, which is the definition of the assertion for stacks (proof lines 3576-3582)
proof_roadmap: 取代数空间 V 满光滑映到 Y，及 U 满光滑映到 V ×_Y X，于是只需证 U → V 局部有限型。
把一切沿 W → Y 作基变换：U' = W ×_Y U、V' = W ×_Y V，光滑性保持，由定义与假设得 U' → V' 局部有限型；又 V' → V 满、平坦、局部有限表现，由跨章的下降引理得 U → V 局部有限型。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is locally of finite type as soon as its base change along a surjective flat cover of finite presentation of the target by an algebraic space is (author lemma at source lines 3553-3559, label lemma-check-finite-type-covering). The proof (source lines 3562-3583) chooses smooth scheme covers, base changes the whole setup along the given cover so that the hypothesis applies to a morphism of schemes, and then descends the property along the surjective flat cover of finite presentation (proof lines 3563-3582). The two reductions, to schemes and back along the descent, are the content. H2.
